contentText: Donald Trump had started his Wednesday pondering military strikes before pouring cold water on the concept, even expressing doubts that Iranians would accept as leader the late Shah’s son. More on that with our panel. In a sign of how fast a news cycle can flip, Iran’s foreign minister expressing his assurances in English on Trump-friendly Fox News. After a ruthless response to nationwide protest, has the Islamic Republic once again seen off an existential challenge?
